items.quote: No required third-party package dependencies; in `Aspose.Words/Aspose.Words.csproj`, no `PackageReference` a consumer would install is declared.
items.truth: The published package declares SkiaSharp 3.119.0 and BitMiracle.LibTiff.NET 2.4.649 (netstandard2.0 and net8.0) plus Microsoft.Win32.Registry 5.0.0 (netstandard2.0); the library's Aspose.Foundation project references them.

items.quote: Chart chart = doc.FirstSection.Body.Shapes[0].Chart;
items.truth: Story.Shapes (inherited by Body) and ShapeCollection are declared internal in the .NET build, so consumer code cannot compile this line. Only the test assemblies can see them, through InternalsVisibleTo. The snippet also uses `doc` without declaring it.

items.quote: The verified public surface has 618 types.
items.truth: At this revision Aspose.Words declares 615 public types (379 classes, 210 enums, 26 interfaces). The README's list adds DocumentPositionMovement, INodeCollection and NodeEnumerator, which are public only under `#if CPLUSPLUS` and internal in .NET. The upstream README itself says 615.

items.quote: | `DocumentPositionMovement` | Aspose.Words.DocumentPositionMovement is a public symbol. |
items.truth: DocumentPositionMovement is `internal` unless CPLUSPLUS is defined, so it is not part of the .NET public API. The same applies to INodeCollection and NodeEnumerator, which are also listed.

items.quote: The full surface totals 618 public types
items.truth: The source has 615 public types for the .NET build, and the upstream README states 615.

items.quote: the complete, browsable reference for all 618 public types
items.truth: The source has 615 public types for .NET. The upstream README gives 617 here and 615 elsewhere; neither is 618.

items.quote: and .NET Framework 4.62.
items.truth: The target is .NET Framework 4.6.2 (net462), not 4.62.

items.quote: The NuGet package and new formats are landing soon.
items.truth: Aspose.Words.FOSS is already on NuGet (26.2.0 published 2026-07-29, 26.3.0 published 2026-09-01), and the README's own Installation section installs it.

items.truth: The source project references System.Text.Encoding.CodePages, but the published NuGet package does not declare it as a dependency.

items.quote: - Requires .NET `netstandard2.0;net8.0;net462` (`TargetFrameworks` in `Aspose.Words/Aspose.Words.csproj`).
items.truth: This is a raw MSBuild property dump, reordered from the source. The csproj value is `net462;netstandard2.0;net8.0`, and the user-facing requirement is .NET Framework 4.6.2+, a .NET Standard 2.0-compatible runtime, or .NET 8.
